text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Almost every single day of ours
begins in a dimly lit room—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: “However, that day…… was far, far too dark.”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(It's... not morning? In the middle of the night...?
Why did I wake up at this hour—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ruby?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Ruby?
Ruby, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, does it hurt somewhere!?
...Excuse me, someone! Dorm Leader!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby is—?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, did you see it too? That news.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You mean the news about Daiichi Ruby?
They found a leg issue, so she's resting for the rest of the year!
That's wild, right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Daiichi Ruby sidelined for the rest of the year due to injury"... The news sent shockwaves through the public in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: "Daiichi Ruby, being the heir to the prestigious 'Splendid Clan,' has naturally drawn immense anticipation and attention."

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: "Following in the footsteps of her grandmother and mother, who both left behind illustrious track records, what kind of performance will she show us—"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"She barely made an impression in the Triple Tiara races,
and on top of that, an injury was just discovered..."

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: “To put it bluntly, the voices calling this a ‘disappointment’ seem to be growing louder.”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugggh, this is rough...
They say I can get discharged soon, but to be real with you, can I even make a comeback after the new year?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
With the mood like this, y'know...
she might even just retire as is—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey now!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're worried,
there are things you should and shouldn't say!
Let's leave it at that!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Disciplinary Committee Chairwoman...!
I-I'm so sorry~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: All riiiiiiiiiight, let's do thissss--!!
choice_data_list: Y-You scared me...! What's gotten into you all of a sudden?!
Y-You scared me...! What's gotten into you all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"No, for real, I was totally bummed out and feeling finished, BUT!!
Isn't this the time? Like, isn't it right now?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If we're gonna hype Ruby up, it's gotta be now, right!?!?
It's now or never~~!! Hell yeahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna go run!! Go train!!
And then, and then!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
With a totally, craaaazy hype race,
I'm gonna hype Milady up to the max~~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
That is truly the case.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Right, I... if only I'd noticed sooner...
No, this is no time to be regretting things.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I want to give you something too... Ruby—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby. ...Welcome back.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ! ...Were you outside?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I just couldn't wait for you to be discharged.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Since we are roommates, I believe there would only be a difference of a few minutes before we could see each other, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: On top of that, the temperature is rather low today.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wasn't waiting
for that long, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I also brought along
some warm tea—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...It has gone completely cold, however.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Looks like it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Is there anything I can do?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
...Could I have a moment of your time?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...It's solemn as ever.
Ruby's house, no matter when I visit.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(A gorgeous, yet solemn design.
The gazes pouring down from countless portraits――)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Please, this way.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"There is something I wish to ask you.
...I have wanted to for a very long time."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san.
I watched your debut race.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ! ...Ruby, you came too?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was watching.
When you—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Without a single shred of hesitation.
Fast, fast, purely fast—dashing straight through.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"……Please tell me, Miracle-san.
Why――"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Why are you able to run like that?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Because that's my reason for living.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Come to think of it,
we've never really talked about it properly.
You were always considerate enough not to pry.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am aware that... in the past,
your health was frail, however.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. I was weak and fragile...
Without everyone, I wouldn't have been able to stand back up.
I shouldn't even be standing here right now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: My healthy body. My legs that can run freely. Everything I have is a miracle everyone gave me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I have no doubts.
I'll give back what I've received.
—Because I've decided to use everything I have to do just that."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I have to wring out every last bit of myself, I must be fast. Fast.
To dedicate this victory to everyone, fast. Fast."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...From the very beginning. Yes, that's what I decided.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...So that is your...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Resolve...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...After that, Ruby and I took
a leisurely walk back to the academy.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(As we were walking along—we saw the beach, and
Ruby stopped in her tracks.
So, I was the one who took a step toward it.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Look, Ruby!
Today's sunset is so beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Red is a color I like as well.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That eye-opening, vivid crimson—especially so.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To me, that color
is nothing less than a symbol of pride.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's why...
crimson looks so very good on you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...In the past, not at all.
She was not in that manner whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "I am just like you. Born with poor leg conformation—my body was never meant for running."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...!
So that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To think that despite being born as the successor to the "Splendid Clan," as an Umamusume...
It is unforgivable. —No, it was unacceptable.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Mother... and everyone in the family stayed by my side and supported someone like me. Carefully and thoroughly, until I was able to run again.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I too...
am only here because of all of you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see. ...Is that so...
We're just a little bit alike, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps, so.
...No, but that is precisely why."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I can only feel ashamed of myself...
...after witnessing your resolve."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... Mine?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "...She couldn't run in the Oka Sho, and missed the break at the Oaks. Then a leg condition was discovered, entirely wasting her Classic year—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, rather than the expected classic middle distances...
My aptitude lay in sprint races.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, none of those.
—None of them are ever a reason to abandon
one's duty, or the very purpose of one's birth.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I will fulfill my duty.
As the successor to the "Illustrious Clan".

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"This blood. This name.
I will make them shine. —Without fail."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It really does suit you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The most brilliantly dazzling crimson surely belongs to you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Ah, oops.
It's gotten dark already...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still... I'm sorry, Trainer.
Could I have just a little bit more time?
choice_data_list: Hmm, well... maybe just a little bit more!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Alright...!!
choice_data_list: Even so, you're more pumped up than usual.
Even so, you're more pumped up than usual.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Makes me feel like I gotta try harder too.
I kinda feel encouraged now.
